content.text: Hello English learners, welcome back to EnglishPod, my name is Marco.
content.trans: 您好英语学习者，欢迎再次来到英语pod，我的名字是马科。

content.text: And today we're bringing you a lesson that was requested by one of our listeners.
content.trans: 今天，我们为您带来了一堂您请求的课。

content.text: We got a request for a dialogue about a receptionist.
content.trans: 我们收到了一个关于接待员的对话请求。

content.text: So a receptionist at an office or at a hotel.
content.trans: 所以一个在办公室或酒店的接待员。

content.text: So today's dialogue is simple, but we're going to be looking at some really great phrases.
content.trans: 所以今天的对话简单，但我们将会仔细研究一些非常棒的短语。

content.text: Yeah, phrases that will help you sound really, really professional and really fluent.
content.trans: 是的，能够帮助你听起来非常专业和流利的短语。

content.text: So we are at an office today and the receptionist is greeting somebody that has an appointment.
content.trans: 所以今天我们正在办公室，接待员正问候有人有约会。
好的，让我们看看会发生什么。

content.text: Yes, I'm here to see Joanna Stevens, I have an appointment at 4.
content.trans: 是的，我来这里见乔安娜·斯蒂芬森。我现在有4点的预约。
是的，我可以问你的名字。

content.text: I'll let her know you've arrived.
content.trans: 我会告诉她你已经到了。

content.text: Miss Stevens will be with you momentarily.
content.trans: 小斯特林将很快与您在一起。

content.text: Can I offer you something to drink?
content.trans: 是的，我可以给你点饮料。

content.text: Yes, coffee would be nice, thank you.
Miss Stevens is ready for you now.
content.trans: 现在，小姐特丽莎已经准备好迎接你。

content.text: I'll show you to her office, right this way.
content.trans: 我会带你到她的办公室，这边走。
嗯，那可真是不好意思啊，对吗？

content.text: That's what happens to women when they wear high heels, see?
content.trans: 那正是女性穿高跟鞋时会发生什么？

content.text: Actually, that happened to me last weekend.
content.trans: 实际上，那天我上周发生了这种情况。

content.text: I fell down the stairs and my knees are quite blue.
content.trans: 我从楼梯上摔了下来，我的膝盖有些发蓝。

content.text: I don't know why women wear them.
content.trans: 我并不知道为什么女人穿它们。

content.text: Well, I don't know, but that's not what we're here to discover.
content.trans: 嗯，我不太知道，但这不是我们来这里要探索的。

content.text: Okay, so let's take a look at some of these great phrases in fluency builder.
content.trans: 好的，让我们看看这些流畅构建中的好词句。

content.text: Well, I really liked how this receptionist used some excellent phrases to sound really professional.
content.trans: 嗯，我真的很喜欢这个接待员用了一些出色的表达方式听起来非常专业。

content.text: And one thing she said was, certainly.
So why did she say, certainly?
content.trans: 所以，她为什么这么说呢？

content.text: Well, this is a nice way to respond.
To make the other person know that you understand what they said.
content.trans: 将对方听懂了你所说的话。

content.text: So, Josh O'Neill said, yes, I'm here to see Joanna Stevens.
content.trans: 所以，乔什·奥尼尔说，是的，我来这里见乔安娜史蒂文斯。

content.text: I have an appointment at four.
So she is saying, I understand what you said.
content.trans: 所以她是在说，我理解你刚才说的话。

content.text: And then she said, may I take your name?
content.trans: 然后她说道，我叫什么名字？
是的，我可以问你的名字。
是的，我可以问你的名字。

content.text: So this is a nice way of saying, what is your name?
content.trans: 所以，这是个好办法，你叫什么名字？

content.text: So now this is really important because if you said, what is your name, is that correct?
content.trans: 所以现在这个很重要，因为如果你说你是谁，那就是正确的。

content.text: It's correct, but it's not really very...

content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: Or I would say, polite to a certain extent.
content.trans: 或者可以说，礼貌到一定程度。

content.text: So may I take your name?

content.trans: 是的，我可以问你的名字。

content.text: You use this phrase when you are going to write down the person's name.
content.trans: 当你要写下这个人名字时，你可以使用这个短语。
正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: So if you meet somebody on the street or at a bar, you wouldn't say, may I take your name?
content.trans: 所以如果你在路上遇到一个人或者在酒吧里遇见一个人，你不会说：“我叫什么名字？”
正确。以下是该短语在中文中的翻译：

content.text: Unless you're going to write it down.
So usually for an office setting where the receptionist has to write down the name.
content.trans: 所以通常在办公室环境中，接待员需要记录名字。

content.text: Miss Stevens will be with you momentarily.
content.trans: 小斯特林将很快与您在一起。

content.text: Miss Stevens will be with you momentarily.
content.trans: 小斯特林将很快与您在一起。

content.text: I would have said Miss Stevens will come out soon or Miss Stevens will see you in a minute.
content.trans: 我会说，斯特伦斯小姐很快就会出现，或者斯特伦斯小姐在你面前几分钟后会看到她。

content.text: But that's not again, it's not really that polite, right?
content.trans: 但是，这不是再次，也不是真的不礼貌。

content.text: So when you want to be formal, you can say Miss Stevens will be with you momentarily.
content.trans: 所以当你想要正式时，你可以这样表达：“斯蒂芬小姐将在你身边短暂地出现。”

content.text: There's so much in this dialogue.
So many great wonderful polite phrases.
content.trans: 所以有很多好听的礼貌用语。

content.text: So why don't we listen to it one more time, but this time slow down.
content.trans: 所以，我们为什么不再听一次呢，这次慢一点。

content.text: I'm here to see Joanna Stevens.
content.trans: 我是来见乔安娜·斯蒂芬。

content.text: I have an appointment at four.

content.trans: 是的，我可以问你的名字。

content.text: I'll let her know you've arrived.
content.trans: 我会告诉她你已经到了。

content.text: Miss Stevens will be with you momentarily.
content.trans: 小斯特林将很快与您在一起。

content.text: Can I offer you something to drink?
content.trans: 是的，我可以给你点饮料。

content.text: Miss Stevens is ready for you now.
content.trans: 现在，小姐特丽西娅已经准备好和你见面了。

content.text: I'll show you to her office.
content.trans: 我会带你去她的办公室。

content.text: So it's pretty clear now, but there are still a couple of phrases that I would like to look at.
content.trans: 所以现在很清楚了，但还是有一些话我想要看看。

content.text: So why don't we look at the last two sentences?
content.trans: 所以，我们为什么不看看最后两个句子呢？

content.text: Miss Stevens is ready for you now.
content.trans: 斯特伦斯小姐现在准备好与你见面了。

content.text: Miss Stevens is ready for you now.
content.trans: 小姐斯特维现在准备好与你交谈。

content.text: Miss Stevens is ready for you.
content.trans: 小姐特伦斯准备好让你了。

content.text: So when she says ready for you, what does that mean?
content.trans: 所以，当她说“准备好你”，意味着什么？

content.text: I'm prepared to speak to you.
So instead of saying Miss Stevens is ready or Miss Stevens can see you now.
content.trans: 所以，不如说斯特伦斯小姐现在准备好或者斯特伦斯小姐可以见到你。

content.text: You use this great little phrase.
content.trans: 您使用了这个很棒的小短语。

content.text: And then she said, I'll show you to her office.
content.trans: 然后她说道，让我带你去她的办公室。

content.text: I'll show you to her office.
content.trans: 我会带你去她的办公室。

content.text: I'll show you to her office.
content.trans: 我会带你去她的办公室。

content.text: This is a lovely way of saying, I will take you to the office.
content.trans: 这是说，我会带你去办公室。

content.text: I'll take you to the office.
She followed it by saying, right this way.
It sounds really, really nice, really polite, really welcoming.
content.trans: 听起来真的很好，真的很礼貌，真的很欢迎。

content.text: And especially if you use it together, right?
content.trans: 而且，如果你一起使用它，那真是太好了。

content.text: I'll show you to her office.
content.trans: 我会带你去她的办公室。

content.text: So it's a really great way of being polite to somebody at an office.
content.trans: 所以，这是在办公室里表现出礼貌的好方法。

content.text: You see that everywhere in the signs.
content.trans: 您看到，到处都在广告牌上。

content.text: So obviously she didn't watch her step and...
content.trans: 所以很明显，她没有看她的步态...

content.trans: 好的，朋友们，我们将在这里等你，直到下次见面，再见。
